tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[the Hopf map has non-integrable horizontal distribution]

Source: petersen:page-0164 ↗ def:pet-ch4-integrability-tensor 1. ch4:4.5.2For the Hopf map $S^3(1)\to S^2(1/2)$, with orthonormal left-invariant frame $X_1,X_2,X_3$ satisfying $[X_i,X_{i+1}]=2X_{i+2}$: $X_1$ is vertical and $X_2,X_3$ are horizontal (though not basic); since $[X_2,X_3]=2X_1$, the horizontal distribution is not integrable. \end{example}
